mapper.select: SELECT * FROM base_dict WHERE scope_type=#{scope} AND family_group_id=#{groupId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND dict_type=#{type} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY sort,id
SELECT * FROM base_dict WHERE id IN #{id}

SELECT * FROM base_dict WHERE id IN #{id} AND dict_type IN (4001,4002,4011) AND ((scope_type=0 AND family_group_id=0 AND user_id=#{userId}) OR (#{groupId}>0 AND scope_type=1 AND family_group_id=#{groupId} AND user_id=0)) ORDER BY id

SELECT d.* FROM base_dict d JOIN base_dict p ON d.previous_id=p.id AND d.scope_type=p.scope_type AND d.family_group_id=p.family_group_id AND d.user_id=p.user_id AND d.dict_type=p.dict_type WHERE p.id IN #{id} AND d.dict_type IN (4001,4002,4011) AND ((d.scope_type=0 AND d.family_group_id=0 AND d.user_id=#{userId}) OR (#{groupId}>0 AND d.scope_type=1 AND d.family_group_id=#{groupId} AND d.user_id=0)) ORDER BY d.id
